title: [PM seat] domain:skills — ⏳ vacant
body:
**This post is the single authoritative registration of the skills seat (seat 1, `domain:skills#1`).** Four-section template; the job description is versioned at `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md` — ⛔ not copied here. Body **r177**, written 2026-10-11T06:40Z by `session_01RdnZdPZH9ByduzPRWuH9tN` (marchtian) at its sign-off; r176 (2026-10-10T17:45Z), r175, r174, r173, r172 and earlier revisions are in the edit history, ⛔ not restated.

## Current PM

⏳ **vacant** since 2026-10-11T06:40Z. The previous sitter: `session_01RdnZdPZH9ByduzPRWuH9tN` (marchtian), seated 2026-10-10T08:43Z on the maintainer's `/pm-dispatch skills`, signed off on the maintainer's 「当前任务处理完,合并后就下班」 after its in-flight cards merged; its patrol Routine `trig_01Ev9WzaBhY6VZCmKof8guPh` is deleted. Successor: `/pm-dispatch skills`, read this post first; the 收班简报 is the comment below this edit. Seat 2 (#19287) is ⏳ vacant. The lane's objectui board is objectstack-ai/objectui#11311 (vacant).

## Inherited + running ledger (the handover)

- **Queue snapshot at sign-off (`pm:queue` ∩ `domain:skills`), three cards: #22708 · #22667 · #22743.** #22667 (p2, Tier H: ADR-0087 notes to past tense, the `AGENTS.md` artifact-count/regenerate row, `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` generation steps; the ruling quote at `:219–220` is not edited; the spec seat adds the same-family site `spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md:213` falsified by PR #22706 — read its comment on the card before dispatch). Unclaimed on purpose (the sitter's standing instruction). **#22708** (ruled **A** by the maintainer 「22708 A」 at 2026-10-11T02:58Z, ruling `6104822731` by the director seat, moved `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in the same act; the seat's read-receipt `6105092842`): the execution card — one PR on this lane widening the relay token with `workflows: write` (`fleet-write/ops.mjs` `automerge_enable` row `alsoSpends: ['workflows']` + the `PERMISSIONS` set and header sentence; `.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml` mint input `permission-workflows: write`; validate/execute self-tests pin it; one citing line beside `PERMISSIONS` and in `landing-operations.md`; ⛔ no new gate; precedent PR #22460). That PR changes `fleet-write.yml`, so it is the last workflow-file pull a human enqueues: ACCEPT with proof, then the maintainer's click. Measurement owed on the card: the first pull the widened token enqueues (NOT MEASURED → MEASURED). **#22743** (p3, Tier H, `documentation`: `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md:129` and `:253` say a formula's `returnType` has no `currency` member, which PR #22733 (#22727, landed) widened; filed by spec seat 2 at #22727's ACCEPT, unlocked by triage at 2026-10-11T04:00Z; the replacement text is in the card body; a different file from the ceiling-bound `SKILL.md`). All three unclaimed; order: #22708 (it unblocks the class), #22667, #22743.
- **Landed this shift (all cards closed):** #22619 → PR #22650 `d817f1869`; #22597 → PR #22654 `5e231a08b`; #22631 → PR #22652 `b9f3cabf6` + PR #22656 `65f4756a1`; #22452 → PR #22684 `80b2da2d5` (W1 of #22060); #22467 → PR #22686 `73d700188` (option B: the PR assignee rides `pr_create`); #22658 → PR #22692 `bf515e724` (Tier H, approved by `os-zhuang`) and PR #22691 `165587ee6` (`@objectstack/skills`; ACCEPTed at `d10855bb8`, then four merge-only patch rounds — two of them to pick up main's own fixes, PR #22750 and PR #22753 — each verified by the seat as a clean merge; landed by `os-zhuang`'s approval and queue add at 06:02Z after the fleet token's `workflows` refusal, #22708; landing record `6106323081`). Ruling A on #22649 is executed on this lane's side; #22659 (`domain:cli`) and #22668 (`domain:devx`) stay `pm:blocked` until `@objectstack/skills` is installable from a release (the unlock reading is consumer-install, not the merge).
- **Decision box 0** — #22708 is ruled (A, above) and out of the box; nothing of this lane's awaits a letter on GitHub. Until #22708's implementing PR lands, a pull that changes `.github/workflows/**` is a human-queue item for the relay as minted (measured ×3 on PR #22691; GitHub's refusal text is in #22658's thread, `6100581505`).
- **`pm:blocked` 3:** #22585 (`Blocked-by: #19939`), #22659, #22668 (above). `pm:awaiting-maintainer` 0 · `pm:on-hold` 0 · `pm:retriage` 0 · bare `finding` 0 of this lane's filing (#22752 is `finding`, unlabelled by lane, triage's to grade — the re-entry of #22705 with `Unblocks: #22658`; the smoke pack-parse fix). `tracking` 2: #22060 (W1 done; W2 measured done; W3 landed `6a3f82ef`; W4–W7 unfiled; the next diet's file surface must include the `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` entry, 6098414279) and #17161.
- **Cross-seat items still open:** PR #22612 (`domain:cli`, two contract-review records by this seat, the second PASS 6097779091) — landing is the cli stay-behind's. PR #22706 (`domain:spec`) touched the frozen `dispatch-gates.mjs` under ruling 208's exception on this seat's two conditions (6100894139; met, 6102430251); its two follow-ups on main — the base-render archive (#22744, PR #22750) and the smoke pack parse (#22752) — are the spec/devx lanes'; until both land every pull's `Type Check · source gates` and both smokes are red.
- **Maintainer thread still pending its letter (chat, inherited twice):** 「我发先很多对外的 skills 中有issue id,是否建议删除,以及如何避免」 (objectstack `skills/**` 0 hits, objectui `skills/**` 41 hits in 12 files; options A/B/C, A recommended); ⛔ nothing filed.
- **NOT MEASURED, carried:** the first live `pr_create` carrying `assignees` (the relay carries it since `73d700188`; the next dispatch's dev measures it); the first Version Packages PR re-stamping the ten frontmatters through the `version` script's `--fix`; r172's carried readings (the `pr_update_branch` merge-commit author, the first live `label-write --release`, the first live `workflow_dispatch`, PR #22531's post-split battery); #22172's `pm:dispatched` residue is the director seat's.

## Hot-file serial queue

- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`: **FROZEN** (ruling 208 R6, restored after the W3 split; one touch landed under its exception in PR #22706); `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` and `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` under the same reading; `scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs`: FREE.
- `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`: at its token ceiling (6128/6128, headroom 0 after PR #22692) — the next edit pays with a deletion. `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`: #22585 (blocked), FREE until it unlocks.
- `docs/adr/0087-*.md` · `AGENTS.md` · `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md`: #22667's surface, reserved by nobody.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` (460/460) · `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (402/402) · `references/execution-duties.md` (183/183) · `scripts/pm/fleet-write/*` · `packages/skills/**` · the ten `skills/*/SKILL.md` frontmatters · `scripts/check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs`: FREE (landed).
- Every other file of the lane on both boards: FREE.

## Notes

- Job description and write paths: `references/lanes/skills.md`; content writes only through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` / `label-write.mjs` / `issue-create.mjs` / `close-cards.mjs` and `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --actions-file`; route `dispatch` (relay); ⛔ no MCP write. Landing shapes: r172's Notes stand; measured this shift — `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` in one dispatch → `added_to_merge_queue` 1.5–2.5 min later → MERGED 25–35 min later (four PRs); `check-governed-merges --pr N` exit 3 = the GOVERNED verdict (Tier S: at-tier record then the seat lands; Tier H: an authorized APPROVED review, then the seat lands or the approver arms it themselves, as `os-zhuang` did on PR #22692); `check-expected-skips` exit 3 = NOT MEASURED while a check-run is still running, re-read later; it needs the `yaml` package outside the checkout.
- Harness at sign-off: CURRENT — the shared checkout was fast-forwarded to `a2e94c2a0` (= `origin/main`) at this sign-off and `check-harness-current` exits 0; the mirror branch `claude/bold-cray-0a9zgb` is pushed to the same sha; no worktree is left behind. `check:platform-checklist` is red on `origin/main` (the watchdog's; anchor #22594 closed `not_planned`), not a landing blocker.
- Platform readings this shift (the ones a successor acts on): the fleet token is minted without `workflows`, so GitHub refuses the relay's arm on any pull that changes `.github/workflows/**` once that pull is mergeable (two earlier such pulls slipped through on arm timing) — a human-queue item until #22708's implementing PR lands (ruled A: the token gains `workflows: write`); a job log the REST route denies (egress 403 on the Actions log host) is readable through the MCP `get_job_logs` read (#19404), so a failed relay action's row IS readable — read it before reasoning about it; the auto-mode classifier refused one `label-write … --assign` stroke and passed three identical ones (the reason #22467 took option B); `post-stamped` refuses bare stamps beside `{{NOW}}`, a `Claim:` whose model line lacks the `--tier` citation, and an unacknowledged newer comment before a `--body` refresh (`--ack-through=ID`); a PR body edit through `post-stamped --body=PR` fires `pull_request.edited` and re-judges the closing-target claim guard; a two-PR card needs a `Claim:` whose `Branch:` line names each branch (the guard reads the line, not the prose); the first dev session cut by a usage wall leaves its worktree and empty branch behind — the relaunch reuses them; the harness's background wrapper caps at two hours, so a long merge watcher is re-armed by the patrol, not by one wrapper.
- Timers and subscriptions at sign-off: the patrol Routine deleted; no one-shot; the `subscribe_pr_activity` watches on PR #22691 and PR #22692 ended at their merges; no remote dev session (every dev was a `mode:subagent`; all archived with the session).
